pages.text: The servants of Isis live in her temples on the Nile. Courted like the amazons: gifts and a ring. They love lotus and flowers, gold and lapis, honey and dates, and trophies of the Duat.
The knot of Isis wins her heart at once, the sistrum of Hathor calls strays home. Give your wife a honey cake and a daughter is born, a priestess too.
